plans.idea: Left-to-right story: brand lockup, then the three-bag lineup (hero bag plus the two secondary bags beside it), then the headline block, ending on the orange 'Build Your Pack' button at the far right.

Product-first: the hero bag anchors the left edge with its two siblings tucked small beside it, a wide central text column gives the headline the most room, and the logo and CTA sit together as a sign-off on the right.
Brand-and-message-led: logo then a wide headline column on the left two-thirds, with the product cluster grouped right next to the CTA so the bags and the 'Build Your Pack' button read as one block.
